Chapter 6335: Just Like That?

Chapter 6335: Just Like That?

Silence Peak had changed dramatically with the emergence of trees and foliage. Life force blossomed everywhere; perhaps this was an understatement.

Calling it an immortal domain was not outrageous due to the precious divine trees and vines. They were beyond the reach of regular cultivators and coveted by the most powerful sects. Only the experts of Desolate Frontier had access to such wondrous creations.

Wonderful coral forests, hundred-dao tea tree, temporal galaxial tree, nine-sun vine, celestial bamboo…

The sight of them shocked everyone. No one could recognize Silence Peak any longer.

Ocean water coursed through the coral forests and became a part of it. They looked like independent oceans issuing pleasant waves.

The galaxial vine coiled around the peak, adding a cosmic feeling. The whole peak didn’t seem to be a part of Desolate Frontier any longer.

The vine and its nine suns turned the place into the center of Three Immortals. Other planets looked tiny in comparison.

As for the celestial bamboo, it could be seen from almost anywhere. This marked Silence Peak as a supreme location, capable of looming over Old World. Its swaying leaves could accommodate all entities.

This puzzled everyone. They had no idea how this lifeless place turned into a paradise overnight.

Moreover, they noticed an offshoot river from one of the nine lakes flowing into Silence Peak, nourishing everything.

“Was this stream there before?” Ancestors stared at it in amazement.

Silence Peak had one of the lakes but due to the mysterious power, its effect was muted. Now, it flowed freely and served as irrigation.

“A paradise.” A desolate god murmured. How could this be possible under the silence power’s suppression?

Within this paradise, a youth sat beneath the hundred-dao tea tree, soaking his bare feet on the new river and letting the current wash them.

Next to the relaxing youth was Dragon-pill Emperor starting a cauldron. However, the cauldron was used to broil meat instead of pills.

On another side, Tortoise Emperor boiled water for tea. The aroma seeped through the area.

Solar Monarch and Crimson Virtue were just as busy, digging one pit after another for more plants. They looked like master gardeners at this point.

This astounded spectators since these were the strongest cultivators of Desolate Frontier. Normal disciples worshipped them as ancient ancestors.

Why were these apex beings performing manual labor and most puzzling of all, why did they look so happy?

Of course, the youth sitting beneath the tree remained the most comfortable. His mouth was greasy from the unlimited enjoyment of meat. He then washed his palate with tea.

“Who is he?” This became the question on everyone’s mind.

Upon closer inspection, the man resembled a mortal more than a cultivator.

“Is this an old ancestor we don’t know of?” Someone asked.

Stronger cultivators in Desolate Frontier were around such as Absolute Ancestor, North Kun God, and Tenth-gen Chen. However, they never had the privilege of being served by emperors.

The only exception was Desolate Ancestor and perhaps Everlasting Jiang.

At this time, Ten-realm arrived along with Goldclad and Lostmetal.

Ten-realm scanned the area, making those nearby nervous. Tortoise and the others became alarmed and stopped their task.

As for Goldclad and Lostmetal, they exchanged glances of confusion. They heard the reports from Alch-deer already but to witness this was a different story.

They disagreed with this youth being called a “supreme ancestor”. In their mind, only one person was worthy of this title - Tenth-gen Chen.
